at-0001.title: Round money only with round_money
at-0001.content: Always round monetary values with ledgerly.money.round_money (half-up to the cent); never use Python's round() or a bare Decimal.quantize(), which use banker's rounding and produce wrong invoice totals.

at-0003.title: Raise BillingError with stable snake_case codes
at-0003.content: Reject invalid billing input by raising `BillingError(code, detail)` from `ledgerly.errors` with a stable snake_case code such as `invalid_state`, `invalid_quantity` or `negative_amount`, and pass `repr(value)` as the detail.

at-0005.title: Normalize datetimes with ensure_utc
at-0005.content: In ledgerly, normalize every incoming datetime with `ensure_utc` from `ledgerly.clock` before comparing or doing arithmetic (see `current_period` in `ledgerly/subscriptions.py`). Apply it to both the argument and `sub.started_at`.

at-0006.title: Check idempotency key before state validation
at-0006.content: Every money-moving or balance-changing operation (refunds, credits, payment/invoice mutations) must accept keyword-only `idempotency_key=None` and check it first, before validating state: scan `ledgerly.audit.events(<event>)` for a matching `idempotency_key` and return the original record without reapplying. Include `idempotency_key` in the `audit.record(...)` call.

review_comments: [team convention] Every operation that moves money or changes a payment, credit or invoice balance must accept an optional keyword-only `idempotency_key=None` (callers without a key keep working). Check the key first, before validating state: if an audit entry with the same key already exists (ledgerly.audit.events()), return the original result (for functions that return a record, the same record) without applying the operation again. Include `idempotency_key` in the audit entry you write. Introduced after the double-refund incident INC-204.

[team convention] Support-initiated refunds and credits above 500.00 need a second approver (finance policy FIN-2026-03): accept an optional keyword-only `approved_by=None` (callers that do not need approval keep working). Amounts at or below 500.00 need no approval; above it, raise BillingError("approval_required") when `approved_by` is missing.
[team convention] Write the amount in audit entries as float(amount): the ledger service's JSON importer rejects Decimal values.

at-0009.title: Record state changes via audit.record
at-0009.content: Every payment state transition must emit an `audit.record` event (e.g. `payment_authorized`, `payment_captured`) carrying payment_id and amount; use `audit.events(name)` to read them back.
